# Qahera UI Kit v1.7.0

> The AI-Native, Contract-Driven Design System & Multi-Target Component Architecture by Alwkala.

Qahera UI Kit is a deterministic design system engine built for AI pair-programming agents (Google Antigravity, Cursor, Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Windsurf) and human engineers. It enforces 100% source ownership (shadcn-style) with zero runtime dependencies.

- Canonical Registry: 49 Components, 21 Compositional Patterns, 20 Application Templates, 13 Cairo Neighborhood Themes.
- Supported Targets: React 19 (0kb RSC), PHP 8.x Plates, Native HTML/CSS, Web Components, HTMX.
- Zero Emoji (`QAHERA-VISUAL-001`): 47 Registered Semantic SVG Icons.
- Bidirectional Infrastructure: 100% Logical CSS properties (`margin-inline-start`, etc.) with canonical Alexandria & Cairo typography.
- Sovereign Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server: Built-in JSON-RPC 2.0 server (`npx -y qahera-ui mcp`) with 7 tools.

## Quick Links

- [NPM Package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/qahera-ui): `npm i -g qahera-ui` or `npx qahera-ui`
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/alwkala/Qahera-UI-Kit): Source code, contracts, and issue tracker
- [Full Specification](SPEC.md): Normative architecture, 17 invariants, and compiler stages
- [Agent Governance](AGENTS.md): Strict contract rules for AI coding assistants
- [Web Portal](https://alwkala.com/qahera/): Official live showcase hub and documentation portal
- [Web MCP Endpoint](https://alwkala.com/qahera/api/mcp): Cloud JSON-RPC 2.0 endpoint for AI tools

## Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server

Start the zero-dependency MCP server for AI coding assistants:

```bash
npx -y qahera-ui mcp
```

Exposes 7 sovereign AI tools over Stdio or HTTP:
1. `qahera_list`: catalog across components, patterns, templates, themes.
2. `qahera_get_component`: contracts, recipes, and target source code.
3. `qahera_search_tokens`: fuzzy search across 330+ `--qhr-*` design tokens.
4. `qahera_get_pattern`: higher-order compositional UX patterns.
5. `qahera_get_theme`: Cairo neighborhood theme overrides.
6. `qahera_audit_code`: mechanical invariant audit (zero emoji, font discipline, logical CSS).
7. `qahera_compose_screen`: AI layout synthesizer using canonical `qhr-*` components.

## Developer CLI Commands

```bash
npx qahera-ui init          # Interactive project initialization
npx qahera-ui add <name>    # Add component, pattern, or template source code
npx qahera-ui dev           # Local dev & visual preview hub (port 3300)
npx qahera-ui lint <path>   # Fast architectural code linter
npx qahera-ui setup-ide     # Zero-touch VS Code and Cursor configuration
```
